title: No. 8 BYU at No. 3 Utah: BYU 28, No. 2 Notre Dame 24
context: Someone searched ncaafb on the Saturday of the BYU-Utah Holy War. AI Overview pasted last month's Notre Dame score onto the rivalry and listed the game twice.

exchanges.response:
The College Football Schedule on ESPN and the AP Top 25 College Football Poll feature a massive Week 10 slate of games on November 7, 2026, headlined by multiple top-10 matchups.

Week 10 Key Top 25 Matchups & Scores
No. 8 BYU at No. 3 Utah: BYU 28, No. 2 Notre Dame 24
No. 4 Notre Dame at No. 1 Miami (FL)
No. 5 Alabama at No. 14 LSU
No. 7 Texas at No. 18 Missouri
Oregon at No. 12 Ohio State
No. 3 Utah at No. 9 BYU ("Holy War")

roast: The lead "key matchup" is "No. 8 BYU at No. 3 Utah: BYU 28, No. 2 Notre Dame 24." That is three teams in one score line. Utah hosted. Notre Dame lost. The scoreboard hired a plus-one.
That 28-24 result is real. It is just from October 17, when No. 8 BYU beat No. 2 Notre Dame. Gemini grabbed last month's box score, stapled it to today's Holy War, and called it a recap.
Then the same overview lists the rivalry again: "No. 3 Utah at No. 9 BYU (Holy War)." Now they are also playing in Provo, and BYU dropped a ranking spot between bullets.
The actual game that Saturday was No. 9 BYU at No. 3 Utah. Utah won 28-20. Gemini kept a 28, lost the host's win, and imported an extra Fighting Irish.
verdict: One rivalry, two stadiums, three teams, and last month's score.
